about: Tariff futures for the Futures module (docs/futures-module.md). Each future is an end state reached by year 5 and held to year 20, applied to every plan on top of today's rates. Multipliers are in real terms (today's money). 'core' futures are weighted equally in the averages; 'ladder' futures are only drawn on the export-rate chart.
